subject: Follow-up: Locale fit synthesis & next steps (EU/APAC)
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + next steps from today's call (locale fit overview)

Hi Anna — thanks again for carving out time today. Joining notes from our discovery so we have a single source of truth and clear next steps. High-level takeaways: 

- Primary scope: clinical triage and patient-facing knowledge retrieval in German (DE) + Japanese (JA) for pilot. Secondary: general FAQs in FR and NL later this year.
- Data: anonymized triage logs (~120k turns), public knowledge articles, and a small set of in-house glossaries + regulatory constraints (GDPR retention).
- Success metrics: intent recall >= 92% on triage labels, hallucination rate < 1.5% on knowledge retrieval tests, and median 95th pctl latency < 350ms for interactive UI.

From Redwood's side we will: provide a short model/quantization recommendation, share a first-pass benchmark and prompt set, and spin up a 2-week evaluation sandbox you can kick the tires on.

Proposed immediate next steps (please confirm):
1) I share the locale prompt bundle + eval instructions (attached).
2) You grant our eval service access to a synthetic slice (we'll send a secure upload link).
3) We run the first benchmarks and follow up with a short findings doc within 5 business days.

Notes on model fit (quick):
- For German clinical triage: recommend trying Mistral-7B-instruct (8-bit) as baseline and our Redwood-curated Llama-2-Chat-13B q4 for higher-fidelity responses.
- For Japanese retrieval + short generation: recommend small instruction-tuned Japanese model and an embedding model optimized for JA tokenization.

I'll attach the prompt sets and the benchmark template now. If this looks right, we'll schedule an access window for next Tue/Wed.

Thanks — Neha

Date: Wed, 20 May 2027 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps from today's call (locale fit overview) — materials + initial findings

Hi Anna / Ravi — attaching the files you requested and summarizing our first-pass observations after running the sandbox benchmarks on the anonymized sample you provided. Attachments: locale_eval_results_v1.csv (summary), prompt_set_clinical_de-DE_v1.json, prompt_set_general-ja_v1.json, eval_instructions.pdf. Also mirrored an XLSX copy to the Drive link below for your QA team.

Short summary (executive):
- German clinical triage: baseline Mistral-7B-instruct (8-bit) achieved 89.6% intent recall on the provided sample. Llama-2-Chat-13B q4 reached 93.4% but exhibited longer tail hallucination cases on long patient narratives.
- Japanese retrieval/generation: our JA-optimized small-instruct model hit 94.1% on retrieval precision but occasionally truncates answers when prompts exceed ~280 tokens — recommend using chunked retrieval with a short-context generation strategy.
- Risk: regression sensitivity on DE long-form notes (we saw a BLEU-style quality drop ~2.4% vs baseline on the longest quartile). Likely causes: tokenization hiccups + temperature defaults.

Recommendations (short-term):
1) German: run controlled eval using Llama-2-Chat-13B q4 with a prompt temperature cap (<=0.2) and a CRF-based post-filter for entity hallucination. Quantize to q4_0 for throughput; we can provide suggested kernel settings.
2) Japanese: keep the small JA-instruct for retrieval and hybridize with a 13B chat model for any free-form responses. Use chunking + retrieval augmentation to prevent truncation.
3) Benchmarks: we'll push an updated CSV (with XLSX) and a prioritized prompt list for the clinical QA team to validate edge cases.

Next concrete asks from LumenHealth:
- Confirm SFTP window for full 10k upload (Anna)
- Confirm access for our eval sandbox: who should we create accounts for? list of emails.
- Any redlines from your DPO re: data retention — default sandbox retention is 30 days for token-level logs; we can shorten to 7 days for the pilot on request and can disable persistent logs for redacted uploads.

Drive (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB3-eval-lumen-locales
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/7349

I can also propose a short 30-min walkthrough of the CSV + prompt sets Wed/Thu.

Thanks — Neha
